pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Classical Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed the f3-knight Nf3-g3-f1-e3 (impossible); plan 1 wrote c3-d4 as one route; plan 4 called the b-file open. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Classical Variation, Central Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 played Nbd2 with the d2-pawn still at home; plan 4 suggested a ...b6 fianchetto. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Classical Variation, Charousek Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 played Nd2-f1-g3 with the d-pawn on d2. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Classical Variation, Modern Main Line
pages.notes: Plan 1 had White meet ...h6 and ...g5 with h4, a sequence that does not parse or fit; rewritten around the pin and the loosened kingside. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Classical, 4.c3 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 3 had White castle queenside for a pawn storm; plan 2 wrote ...exd4 before White has a d4-pawn. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Classical, 4.c3 Nge7
pages.notes: Plan 2 put d4 inside Black's plan; overview called 4...Nge7 the Cordel Defence (3...Bc5 is). Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Classical, 4.c3 Qf6
pages.notes: Plan 2 claimed threats against e4, which no black piece attacks (reviewer rejected; rewritten around f2 and f3, accepted). British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Classical, 4.O-O
pages.notes: Plan 3 played Nb1-d2-f1-g3 with the d-pawn on d2 and the rook on f1; plan 4 said ...Na5 challenges the b5-bishop. Rewritten around 4...Nd4 and 4...Nf6. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Classical, 4.O-O d6
pages.notes: Plan 4 played ...b5 onto the bishop; plan 1 wrote c3-d4 as one route. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Classical, 4.O-O d6 5.c3
pages.notes: Plan 2 took on d4 before White has a pawn there, played ...b5 onto the bishop, and rerouted the pinned c6-knight (reviewer rejected; now breaks the pin with ...Bd7 first, accepted). British spelling.
